{{Article header|deck=The study, sampling and sale of biological discoveries found on planetary surfaces.}}

'''Exobiology''' is an [[Exploration|exploration]] activity centred on locating biological signals, collecting genetic samples on foot and selling completed records to Vista Genomics. In [[Odyssey]], commanders sample organisms with an Artemis Suit and its Genetic Sampler; the Codex also includes surface life first encountered before Odyssey.<ref name="guide">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/en-US/news/odyssey-guide Odyssey Guide], Frontier Developments.</ref>

== Equipment ==

An '''Artemis Suit''' provides the Genetic Sampler used for organic scans. A ship-mounted [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] is used to map a landable body and reveal its biological signal filters. A small exploration ship or an SRV can reduce travel time between colonies, but neither changes the organism's sampling distance.<ref name="guide" />

== Field workflow ==

# Use the Full Spectrum System Scanner to identify landable bodies with biological signals.
# Map the body with a [[Detailed Surface Scanner]]. Select an available biological signal filter and descend into highlighted terrain.
# Locate a colony on foot and scan it with the Genetic Sampler.
# Move at least the organism's minimum sample distance before scanning the next colony.
# Complete three accepted samples of the same organism, then continue to another organism or body.
# Sell completed records at a Vista Genomics outlet.<ref name="guide" />

The required separation varies by organism. Each species page lists the minimum distance to travel between accepted samples.

== Biological signals and heat maps ==

A Detailed Surface Scanner reports the number of biological signal types and provides a Signals Filter for a mapped body. Highlighted terrain indicates where the selected genus can occur; colour intensity should not be interpreted as specimen density, and the overlay does not identify an exact colony.<ref name="frontier-overlay">[https://issues.frontierstore.net/issue-detail/31345 Issue 31345: Detailed Surface Scanner heat map], Frontier Issue Tracker. The acknowledged design response describes areas where organics are likely to be found rather than a density heat map. Accessed 10 September 2026.</ref>

For help interpreting the overlay and choosing a landing area, see [[How to Choose an Exobiology Search Area with a Detailed Surface Scanner]].

== Values and Vista Genomics ==

Completed genetic records are sold at Vista Genomics. Species pages and the organism index show base values; these figures do not include first-to-log bonuses. Frontier notes that first discoveries can pay substantially more, but does not document a universal bonus formula in the Odyssey guide.<ref name="guide" /><ref name="payouts">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/vista-genomics-boosts-biodata-payouts Vista Genomics Boosts Biodata Payouts], Frontier Developments.</ref>

Unsold claims are at risk during exploration. Frontier's Odyssey guide states that losing the ship before returning causes the claims to be lost.<ref name="guide" />

== Organism index ==

The organism index lists the biological species currently catalogued by EDFM, including base Vista Genomics value, minimum sampling distance and known visual variants.

Species names, values, sampling distances and known variants are maintained from Frontier's documented journal records and validated community datasets, including the Canonn Codex reference, EDMC-BioScan and EDMC-ExploData.<ref name="journal">[https://hosting.zaonce.net/community/journal/v38/Journal_Manual_v38.pdf Elite Dangerous Player Journal Manual, version 38], Frontier Developments. Accessed 28 September 2026.</ref><ref name="canonn">[https://us-central1-canonn-api-236217.cloudfunctions.net/query/codex/ref Canonn Codex reference], Canonn Research.
